app.title: AGAT GROUP | BHP Training Platform
app.description: Official AGAT GROUP Sp. z o.o. environment for multilingual workplace safety training.

branding.tagline: Official training platform of AGAT GROUP Sp. z o.o.

landing.hero_title: Safety excellence powered by AGAT GROUP
landing.hero_subtitle: A central learning hub for AGAT GROUP employees and contractors, available in multiple languages.
landing.section_title: Why AGAT GROUP relies on the BHP Platform?
landing.feature_courses_desc: Video lessons, slide decks and PDF manuals tailored for international employees.
landing.feature_tests_desc: Question banks translated into five languages with instant scoring.
landing.feature_certificates_desc: Each pass triggers a numbered PDF certificate ready to download.
landing.feature_admin_desc: Full control for the AGAT GROUP safety team over courses, exams, certificates, and reporting.
landing.company_desc: For over 30 years AGAT GROUP has supported industrial and logistics projects. The BHP platform keeps safety standards aligned for our international teams and partners.
landing.company_point_one: Safety standards tailored to AGAT GROUP processes and client requirements.
landing.company_point_two: Training content curated by AGAT GROUP safety experts and field coaches.
landing.company_point_three: Ongoing coordinator support with transparent progress analytics for HR.
landing.company_contact: Contact the AGAT GROUP HSE team to tailor training to your project.
